messages:
maya: Morning check-in — what I did: finished hero benchmark draft and uploaded the CSV to the bench folder (link). Blockers: waiting on final brand copy from @leah. Today: schedule two benchmark tweets and sync w/ @sam on runtimes.

sam: Got code review for the bench uploader, left comments on PR #412. Can merge after @oliver confirms image assets. Also re: runtime numbers — I'll validate the latency table this afternoon.

oliver: I'm on the image assets, will drop variants by 11:30. Quick Q: do we need 16:9 and square for each pillar? @maya ?

leah: Sorry slight delay on copy — pushing 3 headline options by 10:30. No blocker after that.

bench-bot: Benchmark report uploaded: /benchmarks/2026-03-18/hero-run-1779200456.csv — mean latency 42ms, p95 83ms, cost/unit $0.0032. cc @maya @sam

maya: Thanks @bench-bot and @oliver. If latencies hold we can schedule the post at 2pm PST. @sam can you confirm the inference variant? prefer quantized-8 if quality checks pass.

sam: Confirmed, will run quality checks on quantized-8 by 12:30. If any regressions, fallback to fp16 and we reschedule.

oliver: Dropping images in #assets now. Also uploaded alt text drafts.

maya: FYI scheduling note: need final approval from @growth-lead for regional CTAs — @leah will loop them in. Also hashtags: #RedwoodInference #LLMeconomics

leah: Looping in @nina-growth (added). Nina: can you review CTAs when you have a min?

nina-growth: Got it, will check by 11:45. Small ask: can we localize CTAs for EU landing page?

maya: Yes — add line for EU compliance/localization. I'll update the content calendar: https://redwood.company/calendar/marketing (draft)

sam: quick ping — code review link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/412

maya: Anything else? otherwise I'll go ahead with the 2pm schedule if tests pass. :thumbsup:

sam: All green on my side, moving to merge after @oliver confirms images.

oliver: images confirmed. :rocket:

maya: Great — proceeding. Thanks team!
